VariableEncryption._comment: Random 32-byte key committed because it's test-only infrastructure (decrypting the E2E DB's own variables within a run). Was an all-zero key, which the now-default STRICT enforcement (VariableEncryptionService) rejects at startup — replaced with a real random key so the E2E container boots. Production deploys MUST set their own via env / appsettings override.
